  identity:
    name: Resolve preview identity

    timeout-minutes: 10

      crate_version: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.crate_version }}
      name: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.name }}
      commit: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.commit }}
      short_commit: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.short_commit }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Velnor workflow runtime
        id: runtime
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-velnor-workflow
        with:
          rev: 0dc79895ff1c5e88be7c3822c437e1c5b5282e12

        run: echo "VELNOR_WORKFLOW_POLICY_REVISION=0dc79895ff1c5e88be7c3822c437e1c5b5282e12" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Enforce workflow policy
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
        run: velnor-workflow policy --workflow-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
      - name: Resolve the preview version from the crate manifest
        id: identity
        env:
          EVENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          case "$commit" in
            *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "::error::HEAD did not resolve to lowercase hex" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          [ "${#commit}" -eq 40 ] || { echo "::error::HEAD is not a 40-hex commit" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$commit" = "$EVENT_SHA" ] || { echo "::error::checkout $commit != event commit $EVENT_SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
          case "$RUN_NUMBER" in
            ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "::error::invalid workflow run number $RUN_NUMBER" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          [ "$RUN_NUMBER" -gt 0 ] || { echo "::error::run number must be positive" >&2; exit 1; }
          crate="$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' 'crates/velnor-runner/Cargo.toml' | head -n1)"
          case "$crate" in
            ''|*[!0-9.]*) echo "::error::crate version $crate is not an X.Y.Z version" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          [[ "$crate" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] \
            || { echo "::error::crate version $crate is not an X.Y.Z version" >&2; exit 1; }
          short_commit="${commit:0:7}"
          version="${crate}~preview.${RUN_NUMBER}+${short_commit}"
          [[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+~preview\.[0-9]+\+[0-9a-f]{7}$ ]] \
            || { echo "::error::preview version $version violates the preview contract" >&2; exit 1; }
          {
            echo "version=$version"
            echo "crate_version=$crate"
            echo "name=Preview $version"
            echo "commit=$commit"
            echo "short_commit=$short_commit"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  guest-payload:
    name: Guest payload ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: [identity]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 180
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: x86_64
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: aarch64
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu

    env:
      TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Restore Rust toolchain

      - name: Bound the Mr. Boxington store

        with:

          version: 1.11.1
          cache-key: velnor-mbx-v3-91fc926cb724-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-rust-velnor-runner-${{ hashFiles('.cargo/**', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain', 'rust-toolchain.toml') }}-${{ hashFiles('config/fleet/**', 'crates/velnor-control/**/*.rs', 'crates/velnor-control/benches/**', 'crates/velnor-control/examples/**', 'crates/velnor-control/src/**', 'crates/velnor-control/tests/**', 'crates/velnor-model/**/*.rs', 'crates/velnor-model/benches/**', 'crates/velnor-model/examples/**', 'crates/velnor-model/src/**', 'crates/velnor-model/tests/**', 'crates/velnor-runner/**/*.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/benches/**', 'crates/velnor-runner/build.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/debian/postinst', 'crates/velnor-runner/debian/postrm', 'crates/velnor-runner/examples/**', 'crates/velnor-runner/src/**', 'crates/velnor-runner/src/cache.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/src/execution/mod.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/src/executor.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/src/node/slot.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/src/release.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/src/runner.rs', 'crates/velnor-runner/tests/**', 'crates/velnor-runner/tests/fixtures/backend-parity.yml', 'crates/velnor-runner/tests/fixtures/telemetry.golden.ndjson', 'crates/velnor-tools/debian/velnor-fleet-policy-audit.service', 'microvm/pins.json', 'mise.lock', 'schemas/**', 'schemas/velnor.telemetry.v1.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            velnor-mbx-v3-91fc926cb724-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-rust-velnor-runner-${{ hashFiles('.cargo/**', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain', 'rust-toolchain.toml') }}-
            velnor-mbx-v3-91fc926cb724-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-github-hosted-linux-x64-untrusted-ok-rust-velnor-runner-
          save-on-workflow-dispatch: true
      - name: Restore mold 2.42.0 cache
        id: mold-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/velnor/mold/2.42.0
          key: velnor-mold-2.42.0-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
      - name: Set up mold 2.42.0
        shell: bash
        env:

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$(uname -m)" in

          cache_dir="$HOME/.cache/velnor/mold/$MOLD_VERSION"
          archive="$cache_dir/mold-$MOLD_VERSION-$mold_arch-linux.tar.gz"
          mkdir -p "$cache_dir"
          if [[ ! -s "$archive" ]]; then

          if [[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]]; then

          if [ "${{ matrix.arch }}" = "aarch64" ]; then

          key: guest-seed-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'crates/velnor-bench/**', 'crates/velnor-client/**', 'crates/velnor-control/**', 'crates/velnor-model/**', 'crates/velnor-render/**', 'crates/velnor-runner/**', 'crates/velnor-tools/**', 'crates/velnor-workflow-contract/**', 'crates/velnor-workflow/**', 'crates/velnorctl/**', 'microvm/**', 'rust-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: Build guest agent for rootfs
        env:
          VELNOR_RELEASE_BUILD: "1"
          VELNOR_PREVIEW_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.identity.outputs.commit }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          agent="target/$TARGET/release/velnor-guest-agent"
          mbx build --locked --release --package velnor-runner --bin velnor-guest-agent --features release-build --target "$TARGET"
          test -x "$agent"
      - name: Reuse verified guest seed
        id: guest-seed-reuse
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          seed=".guest-seed/${{ matrix.arch }}"
          if [ ! -s "$seed/vmlinux" ] || [ ! -s "$seed/vmlinux.sha256" ] || [ ! -s "$seed/rootfs.ext4" ] || [ ! -s "$seed/rootfs.sha256" ]; then

            exit 0
          fi
          if ! (cd "$seed" && sha256sum --check --strict vmlinux.sha256) \
            || ! (cd "$seed" && sha256sum --check --strict rootfs.sha256); then
            echo "restored=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          agent="target/$TARGET/release/velnor-guest-agent"
          agent_dump="$(mktemp)"
          trap 'rm -f -- "$agent_dump"' EXIT

          cp "$seed/rootfs.sha256" dist/microvm/rootfs.sha256
          cp "$agent" dist/microvm/velnor-guest-agent

            --arg arch "${{ matrix.arch }}" \
            --arg target "$TARGET" \
            --arg binary "$binary_sha256" \
            '{
              schema: $schema,
              build: { repository: $repo, kind: $kind, commit: $commit,
                       crate_version: $crate, debian_version: $debian,
                       manifest_version: $mv, manifest_sha256: $mhash },
              architecture: { arch: $arch, target: $target, binary_sha256: $binary }
            }' > package-record.candidate.json
          metadata/velnor-runner-release-tool release emit \
            --record package-record.candidate.json \
            --binary "$binary" \
            --out 'crates/velnor-runner/release'/package-record.json
          jq -e --arg version "$VERSION" --arg commit "$SOURCE_COMMIT" \
            '.build.kind == "preview" and .build.debian_version == $version and .build.commit == $commit' \
            'crates/velnor-runner/release'/package-record.json >/dev/null \
            || { echo "::error::emitted package record does not name this preview identity" >&2; exit 1; }
      - name: Download guest payload
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: guest-payload-${{ matrix.guest_arch }}
          path: guest-payload
      - name: Stage pinned Firecracker, jailer, and guest agent
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          arch="${{ matrix.guest_arch }}"
          root='crates/velnor-runner/release/microvm'
          mkdir -p "$root" extracted
          url="$(jq -er --arg a "$arch" '.tarballs[$a].url' microvm/pins.json)"
          sha="$(jq -er --arg a "$arch" '.tarballs[$a].sha256' microvm/pins.json)"
          fc_member="$(jq -er --arg a "$arch" '.tarballs[$a].firecracker_member' microvm/pins.json)"
          jailer_member="$(jq -er --arg a "$arch" '.tarballs[$a].jailer_member' microvm/pins.json)"
          curl --fail --show-error --silent --location --http1.1 \
            --continue-at - --retry 20 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
            --retry-max-time 1800 --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 900 \
            -o firecracker.tgz "$url"
          echo "$sha  firecracker.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf firecracker.tgz -C extracted
          cp "extracted/${fc_member}" "$root/firecracker"
          cp "extracted/${jailer_member}" "$root/jailer"
          test -s guest-payload/velnor-guest-agent || { echo "::error::guest payload missing guest-agent" >&2; exit 1; }
          test -s guest-payload/guest-agent.sha256 || { echo "::error::guest payload missing guest-agent checksum" >&2; exit 1; }
          guest_agent_sha256="$(awk '{print $1}' guest-payload/guest-agent.sha256)"
          [ "${#guest_agent_sha256}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "::error::guest-agent digest has invalid length" >&2; exit 1; }
          actual_guest_agent_sha256="$(sha256sum guest-payload/velnor-guest-agent | awk '{print $1}')"
          [ "$actual_guest_agent_sha256" = "$guest_agent_sha256" ] || { echo "::error::downloaded guest-agent digest mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }
          install -Dm0755 guest-payload/velnor-guest-agent "target/$TARGET/release/velnor-guest-agent"
          cmp -- "target/$TARGET/release/velnor-guest-agent" guest-payload/velnor-guest-agent
          test -s guest-payload/vmlinux || { echo "::error::guest payload missing vmlinux" >&2; exit 1; }
          test -s guest-payload/rootfs.ext4 || { echo "::error::guest payload missing rootfs.ext4" >&2; exit 1; }
          test -s guest-payload/rootfs.sha256 || { echo "::error::guest payload missing rootfs.sha256" >&2; exit 1; }
          rootfs_sha256="$(awk '{print $1}' guest-payload/rootfs.sha256)"
          [ "${#rootfs_sha256}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "::error::guest rootfs digest has invalid length" >&2; exit 1; }
          actual_rootfs_sha256="$(sha256sum guest-payload/rootfs.ext4 | awk '{print $1}')"
          [ "$actual_rootfs_sha256" = "$rootfs_sha256" ] || { echo "::error::downloaded guest rootfs digest mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }
          cp guest-payload/velnor-guest-agent "$root/velnor-guest-agent"
          cp guest-payload/vmlinux "$root/vmlinux"
          cp guest-payload/rootfs.ext4 "$root/rootfs.ext4"
          chmod 0755 "$root/firecracker" "$root/jailer" "$root/velnor-guest-agent"
          fc_sha="$(sha256sum "$root/firecracker" | awk '{print $1}')"
          jailer_sha="$(sha256sum "$root/jailer" | awk '{print $1}')"
          expected_fc="$(jq -er --arg a "$arch" '.tarballs[$a].firecracker_sha256' microvm/pins.json)"
          expected_jailer="$(jq -er --arg a "$arch" '.tarballs[$a].jailer_sha256' microvm/pins.json)"
          [ "$fc_sha" = "$expected_fc" ] || { echo "::error::firecracker sha $fc_sha != pin $expected_fc" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$jailer_sha" = "$expected_jailer" ] || { echo "::error::jailer sha $jailer_sha != pin $expected_jailer" >&2; exit 1; }
          mbx run --locked --release --package velnor-runner --bin velnor-guest-image -- \
            stage --root "$root" --arch "$arch" \
            --rootfs-sha256 "$rootfs_sha256" \
            --guest-agent-sha256 "$guest_agent_sha256"
          kernel="$(jq -er '.kernel' "$root/manifest.json")"
          rootfs="$(jq -er '.rootfs' "$root/manifest.json")"
          case "$kernel$rootfs" in
            *UNSET*) echo "::error::staged kernel/rootfs checksum is still UNSET" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          [ "${#kernel}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "::error::kernel sha256 length ${#kernel}" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "${#rootfs}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "::error::rootfs sha256 length ${#rootfs}" >&2; exit 1; }
      - name: Build Debian packages
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          velnor-workflow release package-deb --package velnor-runner --version "$VERSION" --no-build true --asset-name "velnor-runner-preview-${{ needs.identity.outputs.version }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.deb" --target "$TARGET"
      - name: Guard the deb with the empty-deb-incident checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          deb="dist/velnor-runner-preview-${{ needs.identity.outputs.version }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.deb"
          test -f "$deb" || { echo "::error::missing expected deb $deb" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$(dpkg-deb -f "$deb" Version)" = "$VERSION" ] || { echo "::error::deb version != lane version" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$(dpkg-deb -f "$deb" Architecture)" = "${{ matrix.arch }}" ] || { echo "::error::deb arch != ${{ matrix.arch }}" >&2; exit 1; }
          manifest="$(mktemp)"
          dpkg-deb -c "$deb" > "$manifest"
          awk '$NF == "./usr/bin/velnor-runner" { count++; if (substr($1, 1, 1) != "-") type_ok=0; else if (count == 1) type_ok=1 } END { exit !(count == 1 && type_ok == 1) }' "$manifest" \
            || { echo "::error::deb must contain exactly one regular usr/bin/velnor-runner" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$(stat -c%s "$deb")" -gt 1000000 ] || { echo "::error::deb suspiciously small: $(stat -c%s "$deb") bytes" >&2; exit 1; }
          record_path="$(awk '$NF ~ /(^|\/)package-record\.json$/ { print $NF }' "$manifest")"
          [ -n "$record_path" ] || { echo "::error::deb missing its package record" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$record_path" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1 ] || { echo "::error::deb carries more than one package record" >&2; exit 1; }
          dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile "$deb" | tar -xOf - "$record_path" \
            | cmp - 'crates/velnor-runner/release'/package-record.json \
            || { echo "::error::packaged package-record.json differs from the emitted record" >&2; exit 1; }
          record_sha256="$(dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile "$deb" | tar -xOf - "$record_path" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
          [ "$record_sha256" = "$(awk 'NF {print $1; exit}' 'crates/velnor-runner/release'/package-record.json.sha256)" ] \
            || { echo "::error::packaged package-record.json digest != emitted sidecar" >&2; exit 1; }
          packaged_binary_sha256="$(dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile "$deb" | tar -xOf - ./usr/bin/velnor-runner | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
          [ "$packaged_binary_sha256" = "$(dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile "$deb" | tar -xOf - "$record_path" | jq -r '.architecture.binary_sha256')" ] \
            || { echo "::error::deb runner binary does not match the package record" >&2; exit 1; }
          dpkg --compare-versions "$VERSION" lt "$CRATE_VERSION" \
            || { echo "::error::preview version $VERSION must compare older than its crate version" >&2; exit 1; }
      - name: Upload Debian packages
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: debian-packages
          path: |
            dist/*.deb
            dist/*.deb.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  sign-deb:
    name: Sign ${{ matrix.arch }} preview deb
    needs: [identity, debian]
    if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: amd64
          - arch: arm64
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-release-package-signer.yml
    with:
      artifact-name: debian-packages
      subject-path: velnor-runner-preview-${{ needs.identity.outputs.version }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.deb
      source-ref: refs/heads/main

  publish:
    needs: [identity, debian, sign-deb]
    name: Replace the rolling preview release
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ needs.identity.outputs.version }}
      NAME: ${{ needs.identity.outputs.name }}
      COMMIT: ${{ needs.identity.outputs.commit }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - name: Download preview debs
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: debian-packages
          path: artifacts
      - name: Download preview metadata
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: preview-metadata
          path: preview-metadata
      - name: Assemble independent checksums
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          subjects=(artifacts/*-preview-*.deb)
          test "${#subjects[@]}" -eq 2
          : > SHA256SUMS
          : > assets.jsonl
          for subject in "${subjects[@]}"; do
            name=$(basename "$subject")
            digest=$(sha256sum "$subject" | awk '{print $1}')
            sidecar="$(awk 'NF {print $1; exit}' "${subject}.sha256")"
            [[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && "$sidecar" = "$digest" ]] \
              || { echo "::error::$name sidecar does not match its payload" >&2; exit 1; }
            printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$name" >> SHA256SUMS
            jq -cn --arg name "$name" --arg sha256 "$digest" '{name:$name,sha256:$sha256}' >> assets.jsonl
          done
          test "$(wc -l < SHA256SUMS | tr -d ' ')" -eq 2
          (cd artifacts && sha256sum --check --strict ../SHA256SUMS)
          chmod +x preview-metadata/velnor-runner-release-tool
          tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
          trap 'rm -rf -- "$tmpdir"' EXIT
          for arch in amd64 arm64; do
            deb="artifacts/velnor-runner-preview-${VERSION}-${arch}.deb"
            [ -f "$deb" ] || { echo "::error::missing preview deb for $arch" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(dpkg-deb -f "$deb" Version)" = "$VERSION" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published deb version != preview identity ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
            [ "$(dpkg-deb -f "$deb" Architecture)" = "$arch" ] \
              || { echo "::error::published deb arch mismatch ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
            record="$tmpdir/package-record-$arch.json"
            record_path="$(dpkg-deb -c "$deb" | awk '$NF ~ /(^|\/)package-record\.json$/ { print $NF }')"
            [ -n "$record_path" ] || { echo "::error::deb missing its package record ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
            dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile "$deb" | tar -xOf - "$record_path" > "$record"
            record_digest="$(sha256sum "$record" | awk '{print $1}')"
            preview-metadata/velnor-runner-release-tool release verify-record \
              --record "$record" --sha256 "$record_digest" >/dev/null \
              || { echo "::error::packaged package record is incoherent ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
            packaged_binary="$(dpkg-deb --fsys-tarfile "$deb" | tar -xOf - ./usr/bin/velnor-runner | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
            jq -e --arg commit "$COMMIT" --arg version "$VERSION" --arg arch "$arch" --arg binary "$packaged_binary" \
              '.build.kind == "preview" and .build.commit == $commit and
               .build.debian_version == $version and
               .architecture.arch == $arch and .architecture.binary_sha256 == $binary' \
              "$record" >/dev/null \
              || { echo "::error::packaged package record does not name this preview identity ($arch)" >&2; exit 1; }
          done
      - name: Assemble consumer release manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq -S -n \
            --arg schema 'velnor.package-release.v1' \
            --arg source_repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --arg source_ref "refs/heads/main" \
            --arg source_commit "$COMMIT" \
            --arg version "$VERSION" \
            --slurpfile assets assets.jsonl \
            '{schema:$schema,source_repository:$source_repository,source_ref:$source_ref,source_commit:$source_commit,version:$version,assets:$assets}' \
            > release-manifest.json
          [ -f release-manifest.json ] || { echo "::error::no assembled consumer manifest" >&2; exit 1; }
          jq -e --arg version "$VERSION" \
            '.version == $version and .source_ref == "refs/heads/main" and
             (.assets | length) == 2' release-manifest.json >/dev/null
      - name: Replace the rolling preview release atomically
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          live_response="$(mktemp)"
          trap 'rm -f -- "$live_response"' EXIT
          live_status=0
          gh api -i "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/preview" > "$live_response" 2>/dev/null || live_status=$?
          live_http="$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $2; exit}' "$live_response")"
          if [ "$live_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            [ "$live_http" = "404" ] \
              || { echo "::error::could not read the live preview release (gh api exit $live_status, HTTP ${live_http:-unknown}); refusing to replace it" >&2; exit 1; }
          else
            live_body="$(awk 'body {print; next} /^\r?$/ {body = 1}' "$live_response")"
            if ! live_name="$(jq -er '.name | strings' <<<"$live_body" 2>/dev/null)"; then
              echo "::error::live preview release response carries no name; refusing to replace it" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            [ -n "$live_name" ] || { echo "::error::live preview release has an empty name; refusing to replace it" >&2; exit 1; }
            live_version="${live_name#Preview }"
            [[ "$live_name" = "Preview $live_version" && "$live_version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+~preview\.[0-9]+\+[0-9a-f]{7}$ ]] \
              || { echo "::error::live preview release names '$live_name', which is not 'Preview <version>' under the preview contract; refusing to delete it" >&2; exit 1; }
            if dpkg --compare-versions "$live_version" eq "$VERSION"; then
              :
            elif dpkg --compare-versions "$live_version" gt "$VERSION"; then
              echo "::error::live preview $live_version is newer than candidate $VERSION; refusing to move the rolling preview backward — re-run the LATEST preview run instead" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          gh release delete preview --cleanup-tag --yes || true
          gh release create preview --target "$COMMIT" --prerelease --title "$NAME" \
            SHA256SUMS \
            release-manifest.json \
            "artifacts/velnor-runner-preview-$VERSION-amd64.deb" \
            "artifacts/velnor-runner-preview-$VERSION-amd64.deb.sha256" \
            "artifacts/velnor-runner-preview-$VERSION-arm64.deb" \
            "artifacts/velnor-runner-preview-$VERSION-arm64.deb.sha256"
      - name: Verify the published rolling preview
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/preview" > published.json
          asset_version="${VERSION//'~'/'.'}"
          jq -e \
            --arg name "$NAME" --arg commit "$COMMIT" --arg asset_version "$asset_version" '
              (.draft | not) and .prerelease == true and
              .tag_name == "preview" and .name == $name and
              .target_commitish == $commit and
              ([.assets[].name] | sort) ==
              ([
                "SHA256SUMS",
                "release-manifest.json",
                ("velnor-runner-preview-" + $asset_version + "-amd64.deb"),
                ("velnor-runner-preview-" + $asset_version + "-amd64.deb.sha256"),
                ("velnor-runner-preview-" + $asset_version + "-arm64.deb"),
                ("velnor-runner-preview-" + $asset_version + "-arm64.deb.sha256")
              ] | sort)
            ' published.json >/dev/null
          jq -e --arg version "$VERSION" \
            '.version == $version and .source_ref == "refs/heads/main" and
             (.assets | length) == 2' release-manifest.json >/dev/null
